business_problem: BBVA needed a more complete and faster way to understand customer experience than satisfaction surveys alone, especially across high-volume conversations, digital journeys, and compliance-sensitive service interactions.
solution_summary: BBVA built an in-house generative AI workflow to measure customer experience from operational interactions instead of relying only on surveys. The system ingests transcripts from phone calls and chats handled through the My Conversations channel in Spain, large call volumes between customers and remote relationship managers in Mexico, daily Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey comments, complaint signals, and interaction data from the website and mobile app. Generative AI models classify why customers make contact, categorize free-text feedback, identify dissatisfaction drivers, and connect abandoned mobile-app transactions with later support contacts to expose friction in digital journeys. BBVA serves the results back to teams as AI-generated customer-experience metrics, continuous product and service improvement insights, automatically generated pre-call summaries for relationship managers, and scaled compliance verification for certain investment transactions in Mexico.

solution_components.name: generative AI
solution_components.role: Analyzes conversations and survey comments, identifies pain points, generates customer summaries, and scales compliance review of selected interactions.

solution_components.name: My Conversations
solution_components.role: Provides Spain-based conversation data between customers and relationship managers for AI analysis of contact reasons.

solution_components.name: Net Promoter Score (NPS) surveys
solution_components.role: Supplies daily customer comments that AI categorizes and combines with digital-channel data to find dissatisfaction drivers.

solution_components.name: mobile app
solution_components.role: Provides customer journey and abandoned-transaction signals and hosts relationship-manager interactions that are tied back to support activity.

solution_components.name: website
solution_components.role: Contributes digital interaction data used with complaints and conversations to build broader customer-experience metrics.

data_flow: BBVA feeds call transcripts, chat interactions from My Conversations, NPS survey comments, complaint information, and website and mobile-app behavior into generative AI analysis. The models classify contact reasons, detect dissatisfaction drivers, and link abandoned mobile-app transactions to later support contacts. BBVA then delivers the resulting insights as customer-experience metrics, compliance checks, and pre-conversation summaries for relationship managers.
integration_points: Mobile app interaction and abandoned-transaction data
business_outcome: BBVA gains a more complete view of customer experience across conversations and digital journeys, detects issues faster, helps relationship managers personalize service and resolve issues more efficiently, and expands regulatory compliance review beyond small manual samples.
metrics: between 10,000 and 20,000 NPS surveys every day

Mexico deployment analyzes more than 220,000 monthly calls between customers and remote relationship managers plus approximately 4,000 monthly calls from business customers to customer service centers.

Provides automatically generated summaries to relationship managers ahead of customer conversations.
